# Typical file structures {#Examplefilestructuresforwebscrapedandscannerdata-Typicalfilestructures}

Table 1 provides some example file structures for web scraped and
scanner data for comparison purposes using groceries as a case study.

Table 1: typical file structures

+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| **Scanner data**                              | **Web scraped data**                        |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| **Variable**     | **Format** | **Example**   | **Variable**     | **Format** | **Example** |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Date*           | Numeric or | 20180104,     | *Date*           | Numeric or | 20180104,   |
|                  | date       |               |                  | date       |             |
|                  |            | 01/04/2018    |                  |            | 01/04/2018  |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Store ID*       | Text or    | Store_0001    | \                | \          | \           |
|                  | numeric    |               |                  |            |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Region*         | Text or    | Sydney        | \                | \          | \           |
|                  | numeric    |               |                  |            |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Product         | Numeric or | ABC_0001      | *Product         | Numeric or | ABC_0001    |
| identifier*      | text       |               | identifier*      | text       |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Retailer        | Text or    | Grocery --    | *Retailer        | Text or    | Grocery --  |
| classifications* | numeric    | Dairy --      | classifications* | numeric    | Dairy       |
|                  |            | Cheese --     |                  |            | Products -- |
|                  |            | Entertainment |                  |            | Cheese --   |
|                  |            | Cheese        |                  |            | Block Dairy |
|                  |            |               |                  |            | Cheese      |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Description*    | Text       | 'Tasty' Brand | *Description*    | Text       | 'Tasty'     |
|                  |            | Brie Cheese   |                  |            | Brand Brie  |
|                  |            | 200g          |                  |            | Cheese 200g |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Quantity        | Numeric    | 61 units      | \                | \          | \           |
| (scanner data    |            |               |                  |            |             |
| only)*           |            |               |                  |            |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| *Turnover*       | Numeric or | \$501         | \                | \          | \           |
|                  | currency   |               |                  |            |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
| \                | \          | \             | *Observed price  | Numeric or | \$8.213     |
|                  |            |               | (web scraped     | currency   |             |
|                  |            |               | data only)*      |            |             |
+------------------+------------+---------------+------------------+------------+-------------+
